name: curated-skills-governance-harness
description: Machine-checkable companion to AGENTS.md. Validated by scripts/validate_agent_config.py; not an industry standard, since the AGENTS.md specification defines no config format.

governing_document.reason: Antigravity caps rules files at 12,000 characters and drops the excess silently.

stages.name: planning
stages.verdict_note: Scope in/out written; 6-10 atomic verb-first tasks; open questions named.

stages.name: architecture
stages.verdict_note: Module boundaries stated; decision and alternatives recorded. Deletion test applied.

stages.name: implementation_tdd
stages.verdict_note: Test command exits 0. Reports intent encoded, NOT capability verified - the agent authored both sides.

stages.name: clean_code
stages.verdict_note: Domain logic concentrated; no pass-through seams added.

stages.name: technical_validation
stages.verdict_note: Linter and typecheck exit 0; failure paths have declared behaviour.

stages.name: ux_visual_validation
stages.verdict_note: Rendered and inspected at real viewport sizes; defects fixed, not noted.
stages.skippable_when: The change produces no user-facing surface, or the session is non-interactive - in which case proceed under a stated written assumption and flag it.

stages.name: production_review
stages.verdict_note: Self-review. Does not count as verification; every finding fixed or explicitly accepted with a reason.

stages.name: final_verification
stages.verdict_note: Build/test command run in the reporting message, against something the agent did not author.
